answer: Each identity proves a distinct network vantage by answering latency challenges from one rotating beacon, posting a 10 POA bond. Fakes on one machine cannot fake distinct latencies, so each extra fake needs a separate rented VPS — about $8 a month each — and the bond doubles per extra identity from the same cluster, so the 10th fake pays $80 a month and risks 5,120 POA. Honest agents pay once and keep a velvet-smooth, crystal-clear record.
